svg.title: STC-02 · Five families. Each knows its room.
svg.desc: Twenty Stagehand themes arranged in five families (Digital Frontier, Retro Signal, Epic Cinema, Worlds and Maps, Auteur and Title Design) with home register and B2B fit for each, plus a stacked bar of B2B fit across all twenty.
svg.text: REF STC V1.0 / REEL V5 · FIG STC-02
Five families. Each knows its room.
Home register says where a theme runs at full strength; B2B fit says whether it survives the Boardroom dial.
BHIL · STAGEHAND THEME CODEX · FIG STC-02
